scope: Post-result diagnostic of locked ledger only; no parameter search; 2022-2025 not inspected.
interpretation: Negative gross expectancy before modeled costs: transaction costs are not the root cause.
Stop outcomes substantially outnumber target outcomes; their frequency rises in 2021 while target share stays nearly flat.
Fading gap-ups (SHORT) is markedly weaker than fading gap-downs (LONG) in discovery and validation; both directions remain negative.
This does not prove an opening-gap continuation edge.
